nodes.summary: A convex function on `[0, 1]` that is nonpositive at both endpoints is nonpositive on `[0, 1]`. See also `ConvexOn.le_max_of_mem_Icc`.
nodes.title: Nonpositivity of a convex function from its endpoint values

nodes.summary: A finite sum of convex functions is convex.
nodes.title: Finite sum of convex functions is convex

nodes.summary: The damped total weight `u ↦ ∑_S 4 |S| (1-u)^{|S|-1} f̂(S)²` is convex on `[0, 1]`.
nodes.title: Convexity of the damped total weight
Small-influence case implies the full capped estimate on $(1/2, q)$

nodes.summary: The maximal influence of a Boolean function is at most `1`.
nodes.title: Maximal influence of a Boolean function is at most one

nodes.summary: The capped estimate holds for all `u ∈ (0, 1)` when the maximal influence is at least `e^{-1}`.
nodes.title: Capped estimate when the maximal influence is at least $e^{-1}$

nodes.summary: If the right side of the capped estimate is concave in `u`, the estimate holds on `(0, 1)`.
nodes.title: Capped estimate on $(0, 1)$ from concavity of the right side
Small-influence case implies the open-interval case

nodes.summary: `u ↦ exp (m · u/(2-u))` is concave on `[0, 1]` for `-1 ≤ m ≤ 0`.
nodes.title: Concavity of $\exp(m u/(2-u))$ for $-1 \le m \le 0$

nodes.summary: `u ↦ δ^{u/(2-u)} T` is concave on `[0, 1]` for `e^{-1} ≤ δ ≤ 1` and `T ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: Concavity of $\delta^{u/(2-u)} T$ for $e^{-1} \le \delta \le 1$

nodes.summary: The capped estimate for all `p ∈ (1/2, q)` with `p < 1`, all Boolean functions with maximal influence `δ < e^{-1}`, and all `u ∈ (0, 1)`.
nodes.title: Small-influence residual case of the capped estimate

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
